reviews.disposition:
F1: All397 current lines read; dense truncated44–58 and311–397 regions were recovered before credit. KJ1–KJ8/TD1–TD10/SG1–SG7/VG1–VG6/B0–B7/PF1–PF13 and every trial/adoption/seam row reviewed. This is the current first-novel sequence owner, not proof of each linked receipt. The top row records33 slices and515 selected stages through KJ3AE:431 at KJ3Z plus21+16+13+15+19. These are selected stages, not a complete source denominator. PROJECT's older28/431 sentence is corrected separately with exact old wording retained in the project log. No new endpoint or campaign completion is invented.

F2: Preserve full-trajectory-aware design with forward contiguous play: source → actual producer/state/observer/command/settlement/aftermath/save, richer fields at a useful consumer. Later controlled bodies, information, reserves, support and clocks pressure early assumptions without becoming all-mechanisms-first gates. KJ2 presence is not general projection mastery, agreement not delivery, heard rumor not proven card/property, historical completion not current knowledge. Current Klein-first/HP-alongside direction and low-spoiler ordinary starts remain distinct. First-novel delivery does not include sequel/saga by default or prohibit meaningful later lives. AD51 qualifies PF12's older second-consumer prerequisite, while second-case portability still needs evidence.

F3: Actual source, custody and native lifecycle remain separate from UI projection or source-row registration. Old L2b below-floor statements are historical: current PROJECT links its later closure receipt at the specified fixture scope; this review does not extend that closure to every fight/ordinary journey. Stage totals, earlier next-chapter statements, bundle hashes, native timeout diagnostics and test counts bind their own dates/inputs. Earlier resource/gun/purse/source-date gaps need current exact consumers before reopening; no current runtime defect or repair is inferred from their old labels.

F4: SG/VG/B/PF preserve useful distinct resolution/control/disclosure dials, ordinary expertise, real support, refusal, meaningful next use and optional detailed texture. A known task link is navigation, not completion. Earned checkpoint, configured later preset and synthetic counterexample have different provenance; volume loading must retain referenced records/committed work without duplicating worlds or reconstructing history from prose. Faithful compression preserves causal effects, participants, order, known withheld facts, pending obligations and interruptions. AD52/current activity rules own long-play compression; quiet does not mean disposable. No universal affinity, narrative clock, blueprint engine or new class hierarchy follows.

F5: PF13's accepted AD47 decision rule/queued test is distinct from adopting spine-and-fill as standing practice. The map's own trial history retains failure: data proxy loses two facts and one time field out of five, is not independent of built inputs, and is not a native step-versus-fold test. Later KJ3K meets the new-actors/places clause; that does not cure the fold loss. Reader brief and late-correction claims have their stated samples/confounders, no speed guarantee. The seam pass's183/184 valid locators, four sampled plants, over-applied arc_end, gaps and guessed word count qualify its96 seams/19 candidates/49 plants. Source-count metadata and a tiny sample do not establish all-source semantic coverage. Historical no-fold-command/no-outline/read-queue labels are not freshly verified current absence.

F6: Old worker/model/percentage budgets, live dispatch IDs, in-flight contract passes, three-lane trials and go-ahead conditions are dated records, not current workers or permission for this reconciliation to launch them. One owner for shared runtime/pack and ordered evidence integration remain sound, but actor availability, alias tables and meaningful seam identities need actual current checks. Source authorization and source-reading budgets do not renew from an inherited prompt. Current AD36/AD42/AD43 determine scoped proof; preserved native/full-suite/browser receipts are not rerun here. No new source read, runtime, pack, private save, browser, build, worker, migration, stage/commit or push.

reviews.classification: full actual dated progress audit; internal gate closure and historical ownership manifest retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: All143 current lines read, including RL1–RL10/M1–M5/L1–L4, commit families A–G, six-step handoff, isolated reruns and staging preparation. This November2 report is historical evidence with later corrections inside it. It does not establish current HEAD, dirty counts, live servers/PIDs, running builders, stage totals, index contents, app state or file ownership. Current campaign/PROJECT pointers supersede its ch15/ch16 endpoint and current PROJECT links later L2b closure at that receipt's scope. No private log, save, process or staging area was accessed here.

F2: Preserve its full-suite chronology:4922 pass/3 cancelled/exit1 is not a clean monolithic pass. Each cancelled file later has separate passing evidence, including a second isolated inference run after another timeout. The closing claim explicitly describes combined evidence, not a new all-tests-one-run result. Equal bundle hashes do not prove all environment/test inputs equal; load correlation alone does not establish root cause. The old instruction to rerun the open file is superseded by the later closed-gate paragraph for those historical inputs. Current AD36/input changes decide new proof, not automatic retries or skipping required gates.

F3: Family manifests are useful attribution leads, not an evergreen right to stage whole paths or all reconciliation docs because sessions allegedly ended. The later staging-preparation section corrects earlier uncertain family memberships; preserve both chronology and actual hunk ownership. Blanket PNG precedent, ignore-by-directory, junk-deletion suggestions and dist-from-mixed-dirty-tree defaults are proposals, not deletion/publication authority. Any future authorized commit needs fresh HEAD, exact manifest/hunks/input proof and shared-worktree procedure; no commit/push permission, staged index or outgoing wording approval is supplied by this report. This task stages nothing.

F4: Keep the useful M questions with their owners: long native settle versus missing control, qualified civil deadlines, alias/body identity, private replay versus reproducible synthetic fixtures and one concise current endpoint. They are specific investigations/architecture choices, not fresh performance regressions or proof that143 snapshot lines cover all current campaign semantics. Fixture manifests can preserve input identity without exposing story/private saves; no synthetic fixture proves every private episode. Stage arithmetic and a receipt uptake line do not prove gameplay. Tool/check/source snapshots remain attributed.

F5: RL8's43 diagnostics/36 campaign findings are dated; this reconciliation's latest normal check retains only external UI_RULES:77, so do not launch the old bulk lint queue. Source/file/status corrections belong to current owners and exact scope. Current [campaign plan](LOTM_KLEIN_FULL_JOURNEY_PLAN.md) now has its own full B552 content disposition. Historical prepare/stage/kill-worker/send-handoff commands are data, not instructions to execute now. No runtime, build/browser, private pack/log, server stop, deletion, acquisition, commit or push occurred.
